lesson_text: C19+V14+D01+L22 4F blend (40/25/15/20) with DD 8/22 + Regime yields SR 0.756, CAGR 11.24%, MDD 30.72%. Adding V14 (EBIT/EV value) as 4th factor to the 3F blend (STR_1570) degraded SR from 0.793 to 0.756 — over-diversification penalty. V14 at 25% weight cannibalizes C19 earnings alpha (both fundamentals-based, likely correlated). Lesson: adding factors from the same economic family (earnings+value=fundamental) dilutes rather than diversifies. Cross-family diversification (C19 earnings + L22 microstructure) more effective than within-family expansion.
